justification: Inspected [byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeInitializer.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/raphw/byte-buddy/byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeInitializer.java): it is a small interface with only 3 core methods (`isDefined`, `expandWith`, `wrap`) plus two focused nested implementations (`None`, `Simple`) and one nested helper (`Drain.Default`). The file is ~200 lines including comments, and each nested type has a single cohesive role rather than many unrelated responsibilities. The tests in [TypeInitializerTest.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/raphw/byte-buddy/byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeInitializerTest.java) and [TypeInitializerDrainDefaultTest.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/raphw/byte-buddy/byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeInitializerDrainDefaultTest.java) also show narrowly separated behavior, so there is not strong evidence of insufficient modularization.
